data.heading: Build better journeys together
data.description: A professional partnership programme for travel agencies, operators, hospitality providers and experience businesses.

items.title: Travel agencies
items.text: Collaborate on itineraries and customer fulfilment.

items.title: Tour operators
items.text: Connect quality tours with suitable travellers.

items.title: Hotels & resorts
items.text: Build coordinated stays and destination packages.

items.title: Transport providers
items.text: Support reliable ground and transfer services.

items.title: Activity providers
items.text: Bring distinctive experiences to a wider audience.

items.title: Yacht & cruise operators
items.text: Collaborate on marine and voyage products.

items.title: Corporate partners
items.text: Create practical travel solutions for organisations.

items.title: Submit your details
items.text: Tell us about your business and preferred collaboration.

items.title: Business review
items.text: Our authorised team reviews fit, documents and requirements.

items.title: Discuss terms
items.text: Suitable applicants receive next steps or a request for more information.

items.title: Approved onboarding
items.text: Access is granted only after approval and onboarding are complete.

items.question: Does submitting an application create a partner account?
items.answer: No. Applications are reviewed first. Partner access is granted only after authorised approval and onboarding.

items.question: Which businesses can apply?
items.answer: Travel agencies, operators, hotels, transport and activity providers, marine operators and corporate partners may apply.

data.heading: Ready to explore a partnership?
data.description: Submit your business details and our team will review the opportunity.
